thread:
zoe: Hi all, I'm onboarding remote from a hotel and the MBP (M2) went through OOBE but Kandji never enrolled. FileVault didn't prompt and i can't run brew (permission denied). Hotel wifi has a captive portal. Anyone seen captive portals block enrollment?

marcus-it: welcome @zoe. yes captive portals can block MDM/ABM calls during setup. can you confirm you completed Okta sign-in during setup and run `profiles status` plus `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial`?

zoe: okta sign-in completed. serial: C02Y7H9ZT5WX
profiles status: No enrolled MDM profile found.

oncall-bot: Support ticket TIC-5091 created and assigned to marcus-it. https://internal.redwood/support/TIC-5091

marcus-it: thanks. two quick paths: 1) if you can switch to a non-captive network (phone hotspot) enroll should succeed, 2) we can send a temporary admin token so you can at least install tools offline. which do you prefer?

zoe: I can tether via phone, trying hotspot now.

marcus-it: cool. after you connect to hotspot, reboot the Mac and run `sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-enroll --status` and post output.

zoe: connected to iPhone hotspot, rebooted. `sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-enroll --status` => "Enrolled: No \u2014 queued for assignment"

marcus-it: i see the serial wasn't assigned to the new Kandji server during our ABM cutover. i'll assign it and push an enrollment profile. give me a minute.

devex-sam: FYI if you need to move faster i can grant 1-hour local admin. submit the one-time admin form: https://internal.redwood/devex/admin-request and paste the id.

zoe: holding off for assignment since hotspot is simple. LMK when you pushed.

marcus-it: done, pushed enrollment. after a second run `profiles status` and check System Preferences > Security for any prompts.

zoe: profiles now shows "MDM: Kandji (managed)". FileVault prompt appeared asking to enable and escrow recovery key. Enabled and escrow complete. Homebrew install works now. :party-parrot:

marcus-it: closing TIC-5091. note for onboarding: if new hire is remote and on hotel wifi, advise using phone hotspot during OOBE or pre-assign serial in ABM before shipping.

devex-sam: revoked any pending admin since not used. adding a KB blurb about captive portals and OOBE.

zoe: thanks everyone for the quick help, saved my first-day setup!
